meta.title: How to be alone and miss college and be okay.
meta.description:
Are you alone? Nostalgic? Homesick? Me too! Here's some thoughts on that and how I try to overcome all that jazz.

Instagram: 8thWeekday
YouTube: Here, it's right here. You're on it baby!

You know what would be fun though...SUBSCRIBING! AND FOLLOWING ME ON INSTAGRAM!

Okay so lately I've been feeling a bit alone, a bit nostalgic, a bit isolated (because quarantine + graduating college). So I figured I'd drive on back to my old hometown on Cape Cod and sit and chat about it for a little bit. I think being alone is good sometimes but I'm 2000% an extrovert and I'm SICK of it. I want to do improv again lol.

OUTFIT IN THE THUMBNAIL:
L.L. Bean Insulated Anorak
Levi 501's
Blundstone boots
